name: Marchesa, the Black Rose
clause: Dethrone / Other creatures you control have dethrone.

needs.proposedSignature: add 'dethrone' to CoreKeyword (so face `keywords`, anthem.keywords, grant-keyword and self-keywords can all carry it, which 'Other creatures you control have dethrone.' needs), and add the predicate it is built on: either an attacks-event qualifier { on: 'attacks', self: true, defender: 'most-life' } or a Condition { kind: 'defending-player-most-life' } usable as an intervening-if; plus KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['dethrone'] = 'whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it'
needs.semantics: Dethrone is 'whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it'. Nothing expresses 'the player with the most life or tied for most life' (more-life-than-opponent is about the ability's controller, control-leader is about permanent counts), and dethrone is not a Keyword so it cannot be granted to other creatures either.
